SELECT 
    c.containregistry,
    s.sensortrack,
    s.storetempc,
    s.temptolc,
    s.tempnowc,
    s.tempdevcount,
    s.alertkind,
    ROUND(CAST(ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount AS numeric), 2) as tbs
FROM sensordata s
JOIN container c ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
WHERE ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount > 2.0
  AND s.tempdevcount > 5
ORDER BY tbs DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    c.containregistry as container_id,
    ROUND(CAST(MAX(ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount) AS numeric), 2) as temperature_breach_severity,
    MAX(s.tempdevcount) as num_temp_deviations,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT s.alertkind) as alert_types
FROM sensordata s
JOIN container c ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
WHERE ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount > 2.0
  AND s.tempdevcount > 5
GROUP BY c.containregistry
ORDER BY temperature_breach_severity DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT 
        c.containregistry,
        ROUND(CAST(ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount AS numeric), 2) as tbs,
        s.tempdevcount,

    WHERE ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount > 2.0

    SUM(tempdevcount) AS num_temperature_deviations,

GROUP BY containregistry
ORDER BY temperature_breach_severity DESC

WITH critical_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry,
        ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount as tbs_raw,
        s.tempdevcount,
        s.alertkind
    FROM sensordata s
    JOIN container c ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
    WHERE ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount > 2.0
      AND s.tempdevcount > 5
),
container_alerts AS (
    SELECT containregistry, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT alertkind) as alert_types
    FROM critical_readings
    GROUP BY containregistry
)
SELECT 
    cr.containregistry AS container_id,
    ROUND(CAST(MAX(cr.tbs_raw) AS numeric), 2) AS temperature_breach_severity,
    SUM(cr.tempdevcount) AS num_temperature_deviations,
    ca.alert_types
FROM critical_readings cr
JOIN container_alerts ca ON cr.containregistry = ca.containregistry
GROUP BY cr.containregistry, ca.alert_types
ORDER BY temperature_breach_severity DESC
LIMIT 5;
